messages.content.ammo.guided.medium.em.name: Ion Warhead M
messages.content.ammo.guided.medium.explosive.des: A medium guided round that deals explosive damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.medium.kinetic.descr: A medium guided round that deals kinetic damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.medium.kinetic.name: Slug Warhead M
messages.content.ammo.guided.medium.thermal.descr: A medium guided round that deals thermal damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.medium.thermal.name: Thermite Warhead M
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.em.description: A small guided round that deals electromagnetic damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.em.name: Ion Warhead S
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.explosive.desc: A small guided round that deals explosive damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.explosive.name: Blast Warhead S
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.kinetic.descri: A small guided round that deals kinetic damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.kinetic.name: Slug Warhead S
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.thermal.descri: A small guided round that deals thermal damage on impact.
messages.content.ammo.guided.small.thermal.name: Thermite Warhead S
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.medium.iron.descript: Kinetic damage and the longest reach a medium hybrid turret has.
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.medium.iron.name: Iron Charge M
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.medium.plasma.descri: Thermal damage up close with slightly better tracking, trading away range.
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.medium.plasma.name: Plasma Charge M
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.iron.descripti: Kinetic damage and the longest reach a small railgun has.
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.iron.name: Iron Charge S
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.plasma.descrip: Thermal damage up close, trading away range.
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.plasma.name: Plasma Charge S
messages.content.ammo.projectile.medium.fusion.de: Heavy explosive damage at close range, for medium projectile turrets.
messages.content.ammo.projectile.medium.phased.de: Thermal damage and more reach, for medium projectile turrets.
messages.content.ammo.projectile.small.fusion.des: Heavy explosive damage at close range.
messages.content.ammo.projectile.small.phased.des: Thermal damage and more reach, at the cost of raw punch.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.armored-hold.d: Out-damage two repairing brawlers: damage type and sustained output beat a short burst.
A warden and a bruiser anchored in a scrapyard. Both close to brawling range, wear resistance plating and repair their armour while their capacitors last.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.armored-hold.r: Sustained damage on one target at a time, thermal or electromagnetic damage against their plated armour, and capacitor to keep your own defences running.
A bounty for each brawler. Their wrecks carry alloy, circuitry, plasma charges and sometimes blasters, armour repairers, batteries or a railgun.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.armored-hold.w: A light fit whose damage falls below their repair rate never breaks them; armour-heavy kinetic damage is resisted.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.bombardment-li: Survive sustained guided fire: kill launchers one at a time and keep your signature and speed working for you.
Two lancers and a bombard spread along an ash cloud, launching guided volleys from range. Every volley follows you; none can be dodged by orbiting.
Strong shield or armour sustain with kinetic and thermal resistance, enough reach to engage at 20-30 km, and a strict target order.
A bounty for each missile boat. Their wrecks carry circuitry, guided rounds and sometimes a small or medium launcher, a shield extender or an application enhancer.
A large, slow ship without active defence takes every warhead at full strength.
Combine preparation and execution: break the web, out-last a repairing brawler and reach a ranged threat.
A snare, a bruiser and a gunlayer working together: the snare webs you, the bruiser closes and repairs, and the gunlayer fires from range.
Kill the snare first, bring sustained damage for the bruiser and the reach or speed to finish the gunlayer. A destroyer or cruiser fit is advised.
A bounty for each pirate. Their wrecks carry salvage, ammunition and sometimes a web, a blaster, an armour repairer, a medium afterburner or artillery.
A fit that answers only one of the three threats is pinned, out-repaired or shelled.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.crossfire.deci: Position and engage selectively: fight one threat while the other stays out of the way.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.crossfire.desc: A gunner close to the warp-in and a gunlayer with two artillery pieces far off on the other side. Whichever you fight, the other keeps firing.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.crossfire.name: Crossfire
messages.content.encounter.borrell.crossfire.reco: Kill the gunner quickly, then close on the gunlayer with an afterburner; or arrive far out and fight the gunlayer at range first.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.crossfire.rewa: A bounty for each pirate. Their wrecks carry salvage, phased rounds and sometimes artillery, a tracking enhancer or armour plating.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.crossfire.weak: Standing still between them takes fire from both sides.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.knife-fight.de: Hit a small, fast target: tracking and movement matter more than raw damage.
A lone cutter waiting close to the warp-in. It burns straight at you and orbits tight with two autocannons, and its small, fast hull is hard to hit with anything that tracks slowly.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.knife-fight.re: Small turrets that track well, an afterburner, or a web to slow it. Arrive farther out to choose the range yourself.
A bounty for the cutter, and whatever survives in its wreck: salvage, phased rounds and now and then an afterburner.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.knife-fight.we: Medium turrets and slow, long-range fits miss it as it orbits; launchers apply poorly to its small signature.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.longshot-picke: Close the distance or out-range it: exchanging fire at its chosen range favours it.
A single marksman holding a beacon far from the warp-in. Its railgun reaches well past close-range guns, but it tracks poorly once something is on top of it.
An afterburner to close quickly, or long-range turrets or launchers that reach 30 km.
A bounty for the marksman, and whatever survives in its wreck: circuitry, iron charges and sometimes armour plating.
A slow close-range fit spends the fight under fire before its guns reach.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.missile-picket: Meet guided fire: orbiting does not dodge it, so signature, speed and resistances do the work.

A single pirate missile boat holding station off a relay mast. It keeps its distance and launches guided volleys: closing the range, a smaller signature or the right resistances blunt them, but orbiting alone will not.
Shield or armour sustain, kinetic resistance, and either closing quickly or long-range fire of your own.
A bounty for the pirate, and whatever survives in its wreck: circuitry, guided rounds and, now and then, a small guided launcher.
A fit with no active defence wears down under volleys it cannot outrun.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-base.de: Master several roles at once: close-range brawlers, a repairing warden and a distant marksman.

Two gunners and a warden around a cradle of scrap, with a marksman watching from range. The gunners outrun an unboosted light hull and hit hard up close; the warden carries two guns of its own and repairs its armour while its capacitor lasts. Their phased rounds still bite at 10 km, so a ship that controls the range - or outranges them - chooses the fight. A starter fit will not survive this one.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-base.re: A complete fit: two or more guns, an afterburner or long-range weapons to choose the range, active defence and capacitor behind it.
The largest bounties in Borrell, and the best salvage: circuitry, armour plating, capacitor batteries and sometimes a railgun.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-base.we: A starter fit, or any fit without the capacitor to keep its defence running, will not last.
Choose a target order and manage range against two fast frigates and a distant sniper.

Two cutters and a marksman holding a lane. The cutters close fast with two guns each, and their shields shrug off explosive rounds. The marksman sits far off and will not come to you. Decide what you kill first.
Two small guns or more, thermal or phased rounds for the cutters, and a plan for the marksman afterwards.
A bounty for each of the three pirates. Their wrecks carry salvage and ammunition, and now and then an afterburner or armour plating.
Chasing the marksman first leaves both cutters free to work on you.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-scout.d: Learn the loop: lock, fire, keep your booster running and collect the wreck.
A lone pirate watching the belt. One opponent, close range, nothing the ship you were given cannot handle.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-scout.r: The starting fit is enough. Orbit close so its single autocannon applies.
A bounty for the pirate, and whatever survives in its wreck: salvage to sell and sometimes a few fusion rounds.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-scout.w: Nothing in particular; this site forgives most fits.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.range-check.de: Answer a web: kill the controller first, or keep it outside 10 km while the damage comes to you.
A binder and a cutter working a drift. The binder orbits inside 10 km and webs your ship while the cutter orbits tight with two autocannons. Neither stops your warp.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.range-check.re: Lock and kill the binder first. Small guns that hit it at orbit range, or an afterburner to stay outside its web.
A bounty for each pirate. Their wrecks carry alloy, ammunition and sometimes a stasis web, a capacitor recharger or an afterburner.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.range-check.we: A slow fit that relies on keeping its distance is pinned by the web, and heavy guns cannot track the cutter orbiting it.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.screened-batte: Clear a fast screen before the battery: small and medium weapons trade tracking for reach.
A gunlayer battery far from the warp-in, screened by two cutters that close fast and orbit tight. The battery fires while you deal with the screen.
Small turrets or a web to kill the cutters quickly, then an afterburner or long reach for the gunlayer.
A bounty for each pirate. Their wrecks carry salvage, phased rounds and sometimes artillery, a tracking enhancer or an afterburner.
A fit of medium turrets only cannot track the cutters at close orbit, and the battery keeps firing while it tries.
messages.content.guide.loop.carry-rounds.body: Your autocannon's magazine holds 20 rounds, and a fight takes more. A gun reloads only from the ship's hold, never from the station, and the spare rounds you started with are running down. Keep at least two magazines' worth in the hold: buy Fusion S at the Market ({keyStationMarket}), or open the Hangar ({keyStationHangar}) and use All or Max on rounds in the hangar column.
messages.content.guide.loop.carry-rounds.title: Carry spare rounds
messages.content.guide.loop.choose-site.body: In space, the Navigation panel's Warp tab lists the station, every site with its tier, its opponents and what it pays, and any wreck of yours. Choose the Pirate Scout: one opponent, and the ship you were given can beat it.
messages.content.guide.loop.choose-site.title: Choose a site
messages.content.guide.loop.clear.body: Destroy every opponent. The Encounter line at the foot of the target column counts what is left; open it for each opponent and the bounty paid for each kill, straight into your wallet.
messages.content.guide.loop.clear.title: Clear the site
messages.content.guide.loop.completed: You have flown the whole loop. The sites stay open - replay them for credits, or try the Pirate Base when your fit is ready for it.
messages.content.guide.loop.defend.body: Toggle the booster with {keyModuleToggle1} when your shield starts to drop. Each cycle costs capacitor - watch it in Your ship. An empty capacitor stops the booster, so switch it off once the shield is safe.
messages.content.guide.loop.defend.title: Run your shield booster
messages.content.guide.loop.fire.body: Fire ({keyWeaponsFire}) sends every weapon that can shoot at the locked target. The Weapons panel shows your hit chance and whether range or tracking is holding it down.
messages.content.guide.loop.fire.title: Open fire
messages.content.guide.loop.harder.body: The Pirate Patrol sends two fast cutters and a marksman: kill the cutters first, then chase the marksman. At the Pirate Base, keep range and always fight the nearest brawler. Tier is advice, not a gate.
messages.content.guide.loop.harder.title: Try a harder site
messages.content.guide.loop.intro: A few steps take you through the whole loop: pick a fight, win it, bring the spoils home and turn them into a better ship. Do them in any order; skip any you already know.
messages.content.guide.loop.lock.body: With the pirate selected, Lock target ({keyTargetingLock}) on the Local tab once it is inside your lock range - until then the button says why it cannot. Locking takes a few seconds: the target list counts it down, and the Selected panel shows the formula behind it.
messages.content.guide.loop.lock.title: Lock a target
messages.content.guide.loop.loot.body: Select a wreck and Approach it at 0.5 km. Once in reach, Take all ({keyLootTakeAll}) moves what fits into your hold. Wrecks do not last forever.
messages.content.guide.loop.loot.title: Loot the wreck
messages.content.guide.loop.move.body: Select a pirate in the view or in the Local tab's list ({keySpaceSelectNext} steps through them), then Orbit ({keyMovementOrbit}), Approach ({keyMovementApproach}) or Keep range ({keyMovementKeepRange}) at the distance in the range box. You command the ship; it flies itself.
messages.content.guide.loop.move.title: Give a movement order
messages.content.guide.loop.ready.body: On the Overview ({keyStationHub}), use Repair all and Resupply ammunition. Repairing the shield is free and recharges the capacitor with it - do it even when nothing is broken, because a ship that undocks on an empty capacitor cannot run its booster.
messages.content.guide.loop.ready.title: Get the ship ready
messages.content.guide.loop.return.body: On the Warp tab, choose Borrell Harbour and warp home, then Dock ({keyNavigationDock}) when you arrive - or press Return to station ({keyNavigationRetreat}), which does whichever comes next. It works mid-fight too: leaving a site is always allowed, and the pirates do not follow.
messages.content.guide.loop.return.title: Return and dock
messages.content.guide.loop.sell.body: Open the Market ({keyStationMarket}), switch to Sell and sell salvage you cannot use. Keep modules and ammunition your next fit wants - the hold's contents are listed there too.
messages.content.guide.loop.sell.title: Sell your loot
messages.content.guide.loop.title: Flight school
messages.content.guide.loop.undock.body: Open Departure ({keyStationDeparture}) and press Undock - you choose where to fly once you are in space. The station warns you first about anything a fight would punish, such as a gun with no ammunition or no spare rounds in the hold, and shows how charged your capacitor is.
messages.content.guide.loop.undock.title: Undock
messages.content.guide.loop.upgrade.body: Buy an upgrade at the Market - a second autocannon is the first big step - then open Fitting ({keyStationFitting}), use Change module on an empty weapon slot and Apply fit. The Ship view shows what changed and why.
messages.content.guide.loop.upgrade.title: Improve the fit
messages.content.guide.loop.warp.body: On the Warp tab, set Arrive at to 10 km, then Warp ({keyNavigationWarp}) to the site you chose. Nothing moves while the clock is paused, so Resume ({keyTimeToggle}) if it is. From farther out the flight in takes minutes; at 10 km the pirate comes to you.
messages.content.guide.loop.warp.title: Warp to the site
messages.content.guide.progression.buy-hull.body: The market sells the destroyer and the cruiser as bare hulls: no modules, no ammunition. Budget for a complete fit, magazines and spare rounds before you buy, and keep enough to repair or rebuy if it is lost.
messages.content.guide.progression.buy-hull.title: Buy a larger hull
messages.content.guide.progression.completed: You have met every choice this release adds. Easy sites stay open and keep paying; harder ones reward the fit that answers them.
messages.content.guide.progression.guided.body: Launchers ignore tracking. A guided round flies to its target and explodes on contact; it lands fully when the target's signature is at least the explosion radius and it moves no faster than the explosion velocity. Small, fast targets take less. A round that cannot reach before its flight time ends misses.
messages.content.guide.progression.guided.title: Fire guided rounds
messages.content.guide.progression.intro: Beyond the first loop: reading a site before you pick it, guided rounds, webs, and growing into a larger ship. Each step completes the first time you do the thing.
messages.content.guide.progression.read-site.body: Destinations are grouped into entry, developed and advanced bands. Each briefing names the threats, what answers them and which fits they punish. Sites marked fit-sensitive punish a particular fit rather than a lack of damage, so refit before you warp to one. Bands are advice: every site stays open.
messages.content.guide.progression.read-site.titl: Read a site before you pick it
messages.content.guide.progression.switch-ship.bo: Every ship you own here keeps its own fit, cargo, damage and insurance. Switch the active ship on the Ships page while docked; move equipment between hangar and holds yourself. A larger ship hits harder but is slower and easier to hit - the old one still suits fast targets.
messages.content.guide.progression.title: Choosing your fights
messages.content.guide.progression.web.body: A web halves your top speed while it holds, but never stops a warp. Kill the ship carrying it and the effect ends when it runs out; or keep outside its 10 km reach. The speed readout names every web on you and how long it has left.
messages.content.guide.progression.web.title: Break a web
messages.content.hull.independent.cruiser.descrip: An independent cruiser that fits medium weapons and defences as well as small ones. It can dominate fights that used to be dangerous, but it is the slowest and most expensive hull to fit, repair and replace, and medium weapons struggle against small, fast targets.
messages.content.hull.independent.cruiser.name: Citadel
messages.content.hull.independent.cruiser.trait.d: Far deeper shield, armour and hull than a destroyer.
messages.content.hull.independent.cruiser.trait.m: Accepts small and medium modules; small weapons keep their own small-weapon performance.
messages.content.hull.independent.cruiser.trait.s: The slowest hull with the largest signature: it cannot choose its range against a fast enemy.
messages.content.hull.independent.destroyer.descr: An independent destroyer: twice the small weapons of a frigate on a broader, slower frame. It hits harder and lasts longer, but it is easier to hit, slower to turn and dearer to fit and to lose. It takes small modules only.
messages.content.hull.independent.destroyer.name: Bulwark
messages.content.hull.independent.destroyer.trait: A larger signature and slower turns than a frigate: small, fast enemies find it easier to hit and harder to catch.
Four weapon slots for small turrets or launchers, and room for more support.
messages.content.hull.independent.starter.descrip: An independent light hull sold at every neutral station. It does nothing outstandingly well and nothing badly, which is what makes it the ship a pilot starts and restarts in.
messages.content.hull.independent.starter.name: Wayfarer
messages.content.hull.independent.starter.trait.v: Fits any small weapon and enough support to survive a mistake.
messages.content.hull.pirate.raider.description: A heavier pirate hull carrying armour and a second gun, and quicker than it looks.
messages.content.hull.pirate.raider.name: Corsair
messages.content.hull.pirate.raider.trait.armoure: Armoured, faster than an unboosted light hull and willing to trade hits.
messages.content.hull.pirate.scout.description: A stripped-down pirate hull that trades armour for speed.
messages.content.hull.pirate.scout.name: Cutlass
messages.content.hull.pirate.scout.trait.fast: Fast, fragile and hard to hit at range.
messages.content.item.commodity.coolant.descripti: Station-grade coolant. Always bought, never scarce for long.
messages.content.item.commodity.coolant.name: Reactor Coolant
messages.content.item.salvage.alloy.description: Scorched hull plating. Worth something to a station foundry.
messages.content.item.salvage.alloy.name: Burned Alloy Plate
messages.content.item.salvage.circuitry.descripti: Targeting electronics, mostly intact. Stations buy these.
messages.content.item.salvage.circuitry.name: Charred Circuitry
messages.content.module.amplifier.shield.descript: Passive shield resistance, strongest against electromagnetic and thermal damage. It needs no capacitor.
messages.content.module.amplifier.shield.name: Shield Resistance Amplifier
Adds a large amount of capacitor capacity for a hull that accepts medium modules.
messages.content.module.capacitor.battery.small.d: Adds capacitor capacity, which lengthens how long active modules can keep running.
messages.content.module.capacitor.recharger.descr: Shortens capacitor recharge time, so active modules recover faster. It adds no capacity.
messages.content.module.capacitor.recharger.name: Capacitor Recharger
messages.content.module.launcher.guided.medium.de: Launches medium guided projectiles with heavy warheads. Their large explosions lose much of their damage against small or fast targets.
messages.content.module.launcher.guided.small.des: Launches small guided projectiles. Damage lands on impact after a flight, and depends on the target's signature and speed rather than on tracking.
messages.content.module.plating.armor.small.descr: Passive resistance across every damage type. It needs no capacitor and never stops working.
messages.content.module.plating.armor.small.name: Small Armour Plating
messages.content.module.propulsion.afterburner.me: Raises a larger hull's maximum speed while it cycles, for a higher capacitor cost than the small model.
messages.content.module.propulsion.afterburner.sm: Raises maximum speed while it cycles, which changes both how quickly you close and how well guns track you.
messages.content.module.repair.armor.medium.descr: Restores a large amount of armour at the end of each cycle. Needs a hull that accepts medium modules and plenty of capacitor.
messages.content.module.repair.armor.medium.name: Medium Armour Repairer
messages.content.module.repair.armor.small.descri: Restores armour at the end of each cycle. Strong recovery for a heavy capacitor cost.
messages.content.module.repair.armor.small.name: Small Armour Repairer
messages.content.module.shield.booster.medium.des: Restores a large amount of shield at the end of each cycle, at a heavy capacitor cost.
messages.content.module.shield.booster.small.desc: Restores shield at the end of each cycle, faster than an armour repairer but hungrier still.
messages.content.module.shield.booster.small.name: Small Shield Booster
messages.content.module.shield.extender.descripti: Adds shield hit points, a larger buffer that also regenerates. It makes the ship a slightly larger target.
messages.content.module.shield.extender.name: Shield Extender
messages.content.module.shield.recharger.descript: Shortens shield recharge time, so the shield recovers faster between and during fights without any capacitor.
messages.content.module.shield.recharger.name: Shield Recharger
messages.content.module.turret.artillery.small.de: A long-range projectile turret with a heavy, slow volley. It needs no capacitor but tracks a close, orbiting target badly.
A medium projectile turret for cruisers. Strong close-range damage with no capacitor cost, but its large shells apply poorly to small, fast targets.
messages.content.module.turret.autocannon.small.d: A short-range projectile turret. It draws no capacitor and hits fast-moving targets well inside its optimal range.
messages.content.module.turret.blaster.small.desc: A short-range hybrid turret with the highest damage and tracking of any small turret. It draws capacitor and barely reaches beyond a few kilometres.
messages.content.module.turret.blaster.small.name: Light Blaster
messages.content.module.turret.railgun.medium.des: A long-range medium hybrid turret. Heavy damage at range for a capacitor cost; a small target close by is very hard for it to hit.
messages.content.module.turret.railgun.small.desc: A long-range hybrid turret. It reaches far beyond an autocannon but tracks a close, fast target poorly.
messages.content.module.turret.railgun.small.name: 75mm Railgun
messages.content.module.upgrade.damage.hybrid.des: Raises the damage of hybrid turrets only: blasters and railguns. Other weapons are unaffected.
messages.content.module.upgrade.damage.projectile: Raises the damage of projectile turrets only: autocannons and artillery. Other weapons are unaffected.
messages.content.module.upgrade.guided.descriptio: Shrinks guided explosions and speeds them up, so more of each impact lands on small or fast targets. It does not raise listed damage.
messages.content.module.upgrade.guided.name: Guided Application Enhancer
messages.content.module.upgrade.tracking.descript: Improves the tracking of every turret, so shots land on closer, faster targets. Guided weapons do not use tracking.
messages.content.module.upgrade.tracking.name: Tracking Enhancer
messages.content.module.web.small.description: Slows one locked target within 10 km: each completed cycle halves its maximum speed until the next cycle would complete. It never stops the target warping and does nothing to its guns or defences.
messages.content.module.web.small.name: Stasis Web
messages.content.notify.combat.defense-starved: {module} is waiting: not enough capacitor to run it.
messages.content.notify.combat.hull-damaged: Your hull is taking damage - the ship is close to destruction.
messages.content.notify.combat.lock-out-of-range: Lock on {target} lost: it moved out of lock range.
messages.content.notify.combat.propulsion-starved: {module} is waiting: not enough capacitor to run it.
messages.content.notify.combat.weapon-idle: {module} has reloaded but is not firing. Fire again to use it.
messages.content.notify.combat.weapon-starved: {module} stopped: not enough capacitor for its next cycle.
messages.content.notify.combat.webbed: {attacker} is slowing your ship with a web. Kill it or get out of its range; you can still warp.
messages.content.notify.encounter.completed: {encounter} cleared. Loot the wrecks, then warp home and dock.
messages.content.notify.encounter.wreck: A wreck is ready to loot.
messages.content.notify.navigation.docked: {station}: docked. Repairs, resupply and the market are open.
messages.content.notify.navigation.low-capacitor: You undocked with {percent}% capacitor. It recharges slowly while time runs; the station's free repair fills it at once.
messages.content.notify.recovery.ship-granted: The recovery service supplied a starter ship with its original fit.
messages.content.notify.recovery.ship-lost: Your {hull} was destroyed. The loss report at the station explains why.

messages.content.station.borrell.harbour.descript: An independent harbour station. It sells what a pilot needs to start again and asks no questions about standings.
messages.content.station.borrell.harbour.name: Borrell Harbour
messages.content.system.borrell.name: Borrell
